title: Finite-stalk filtered approximation through generic direct image and cohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated integral scheme, $K=k(X)$, $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$ its generic point, and $M$ a torsion abelian etale sheaf on $\operatorname{Spec}K$. There exist a small filtered category $I$, a diagram $F:I\to\operatorname{Ab}((\operatorname{Spec}K)_{\mathrm{et}})$ and compatible maps $\iota_i:F_i\to M$ such that every $F_i$ is torsion with finite stalk at $\operatorname{Spec}\overline K$, these maps exhibit $M$ as their colimit, and for every $q\geq0$ the maps $H^q(X,\eta_*F_i)\to H^q(X,\eta_*M)$ exhibit the latter group as their colimit. The index category may have the universe of the geometric stalk; no cardinality bound on $M$ is imposed.

Apply preservation of the mapped cohomology cocones to the resulting colimit cocone in every degree q.

theorem exists_generic_torsion_finite_stalk_colimit
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (M : Sheaf (Spec X.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hM : M.IsTorsion) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : SmallCategory I) (_ : IsFiltered I)
      (F : I ⥤ Sheaf (Spec X.functionField).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
      (ι : F ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj M),
      (∀ i, (F.obj i).IsTorsion) ∧
      (∀ i, Finite (((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap X.functionField (AlgebraicClosure X.functionField))))).sheafFiber
            (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj (F.obj i))) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk M ι))
